claim_a: CAPGrasp is only trained on successful grasps, so it can generate unsuccessful grasps between the modes.
claim_b: Our method is the first to learn to generate diverse 6-DoF grasps on novel objects and scenes for specifiable target objects using only simulated training data, without requiring a full explicit 3D reconstruction.

claim_a: 6D grasp pose annotation in 3D is more complicated than 2D image alternatives
claim_b: Novel grasp representation that treats 3D points of the recorded point cloud as potential grasp contacts and roots the full 6-DoF grasp pose and width in the observed point cloud, reducing the representation to 4-DoF.
